claims_and_derivations.statement: Three noncoplanar angularmomentum vectors in a stated triaxial-reference model have nonzero scalar triple product; this is a geometry condition, not universal sufficient proof of a static chiral doublet.
Under strong+EM parity-conservingH and neglect weakPV, states can be chosen goodparity; intrinsic shape asymmetry and laboratory parity are distinct.
Within a chosen projected trialspace, parity/angularmomentum normalization andK mixing use fullnorm andH kernels; good quantum numbers do not certify complete variational space.

Under explicitlyfixed directedtriaxialaxes and beta30only, P reversesbeta30 butleaves axialχ; C=T Ryπ reversesboth;PC preservesbeta30and flipsχ. Antiunitary squares+1donot implyKramers norfourindependentprojectedstates. Genericbeta3mu andcorevsTotalparity requireseparatecheck.
q3=-sqrt(7/2)<[Q2×Q2]2·Q2> matches1.2/2.4 normalization and has e³fm⁶. R=q3/q2^1.5 is generally a correlated moment ratio, not purecos3γ or universallyboundedangle. β3 andE3operator are distinct.
Translational-invariantD0=e(N/A)Σpzp−e(Z/A)Σnzn, neglecting nucleonmass difference. Proportionalproton/neutrondensities giveD0=0 even withpearshape. No universalC_D AZβ2β3 formula inferred.

Δl=Δj=3 high-j pairs favor octupolecoupling, not a universal E3 selectionrule. p3/2,f5/2 pseudospinlabels have ltilde2 but do not prove exactpseudospinsymmetry. 2019thesisneutronp/f and2022journalprotonp/f assignments are version-specific.
B1/B2 hasunitsfm^-2; for same-mother efficiency-corrected photonintensities use(CE2/CE1)(I1/I2)(E2^5/E1^3) without extraICC. CE2/CE1=3/[100(ℏc)²]≈7.71e-7MeV^-2fm^-2.

D0 ratioinversion needs externalQ0 and a statedstrongcouplingconversion; externalQ0 can be experimental or adoptedmodelinput. AbsoluteB1 from lifetime+branches/mixing/ICC offers another model-dependentroute.
For available opposite-parity neighboringstates,δE=E−(I)−[(I+1)E+(I−1)+IE+(I+1)]/(2I+1) subtracts a smoothrotorbaseline; no universalstatic/dynamic inference from magnitude alone.

Liu2016Fig1/Tabletext showBand4lowest6−, not7−. Xiao2019PDF40/47 neutronp/f assignment and candidatepseudospin labels are distinctfromXiao2022PDF7protonp/f assignment; no unique negative-band mapping inferred. Statistics6.17e9 versus1.9e9 keptin own reportnormalizations.
